content.text: The assignment provisions meet the preferred position in full.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 matches our preferred position: 24.1 gives Customer a consent-free affiliate/successor (M&A) assignment right on prompt notice; 24.2 restricts Vendor assignment, delegation and transfer by change of control to Customer's consent (not unreasonably withheld) and bars assignment to a direct Customer competitor; 24.3 applies a reasonable-consent standard to other assignments; and 24.4 confirms Customer's change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service. Section 13.3 aligns licence transfer with permitted Section 24 assignments, and no other provision creates a change-of-control exit or re-pricing right for Vendor (9.2 is a standard insolvency clause that expressly excludes lawful reorganizations). No redline needed.
